Sunday in Ordinary Time October 4 2026 For this reason today I invite all the faithful and all Christian communities to pray the holy rosary throughout the coming month of October with the particular intention that wars may cease and that peace may be established among peoples in conflict Let us accompany this prayer with concrete acts of penance and mercy committing ourselves always to fostering dialogue and reconciliation Pope Leo XIV Angelus Address Lourdes Sept 27 2026 Parish Renovations Where We're At This past Tuesday we had a three hour long punch list walk through with our construction team This walk through is meant to identify any remaining incomplete damaged or incorrect work that must be fixed before closing out our project One major concern raised throughout the walk through was the finish work on our woodworking There were a number of visible issues with the final sanding staining and sealing throughout As I write this column our team from Shawnee Construction are having internal discussions on how to remedy these issues We discussed a number of possibilities during the walk through so I am looking forward to what will be presented to us as possible solutions It is my hope that any solutions presented will allow for the majority of repair work to be done outside of the Church to allow use of the sanctuary and be the least inconvenient to us Despite this setback I have asked for the all clear to return us to the sanctuary This all clear would mean that though work is not yet complete the sanctuary is guaranteed safe for regular use With additional work already scheduled through this week it is my hope that we can re open the sanctuary for use next weekend In anticipation for this we are also moving items back to the sacristy making setup for our Masses much easier This past week local Stylus Technologies spent several hours ensuring that our sound and livestreaming systems are up and running properly In addition to this service work they've completed a full upgrade of our church sound system including a new audio mixer and processor These improvements give us greater control over the sound throughout the church helping ensure that both the spoken word and sacred music can be heard clearly Liturgical and Altar Arrangements As mentioned last weekend I have been contemplating our use of liturgical arrangements as we prepare to return to celebrating Mass in the sanctuary Contemplating Desiderio desideravi one of Pope Francis last apostolic letters we are encouraged to utilize the various riches given to us in the rituals set down by the Church This includes among various items altar arrangements Wanting to make use of both of these options permitted by the Church I am considering having our Friday 8:30AM and Sunday 10:00AM Masses offered ad orientem and our five other daily Masses and 5 PM Saturday and 7:30AM Sunday Masses offered versus populum This will allows us to offer a variety of liturgical options to grow with as we gather to worship the Lord Please see last weekend's bulletin column for a further write up on this topic 40th Annual Bishop's Appeal special Thank You to all those who have already returned their pledge cards for the 40th Annual Bishop's Appeal This year's theme United in Mission highlights how we are united in our mission to spread the fire of God's love the Gospel of Jesus Christ in our diocese This includes through our charitable outreach which extends well beyond our parish itself This annual diocesan appeal helps to fund various ministries and outreaches throughout the fourteen counties that make up our diocese including support of parishes seminarian education and Catholic Charities Our 40th Annual Bishop's Appeal Goal this year is 3741464 All donations above our parish goal will be returned directly to our parish To learn more about the appeal or to make a donation online visit wwwdiocesefwsborgaba Saturday October 3 400 4:45pm Confession 5:00pm Our Parish Family
